description.value: Founded in 2010 in Richmond, BC, Sing Yee Chinese Restaurant is a well-regarded Cantonese dining destination led by Master Chef Tony, who brings over 30 years of culinary experience from acclaimed Chinese restaurants and culinary groups. The kitchen specialises in traditional hand-crafted dishes such as Crispy Squab, Eight Treasure Duck, and Double Boiled Winter Melon Soup, alongside a Chiuzhou-style supper menu and advance-order specialties like Fotiaoqiang and snake soup. Cyclists seeking authentic Cantonese cuisine in Richmond can dine in or order takeout online or by phone.

bike_parking_detail: 4 racks within 100m: rack at 32m; rack at 51m; stands at 70m; rack at 84m.
